biggest_catch: You cannot touch your money until you hit $20 AND redeem at least one offer — and after 180 days of inactivity Ibotta deducts $3.99 every 30 days from your balance.
catches: $20.00 minimum withdrawal threshold; must also redeem at least one qualifying offer
New accounts: 7-day wait after first offer redemption before first withdrawal
$3.99 account maintenance fee per 30 days after 180 days of inactivity
Phone number verification required before withdrawing
One account per person/device; submitting others' receipts leads to deactivation
Some gift cards have a $25 minimum purchase

steps: Download the official Ibotta app from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store (free).
Create a free Ibotta account with your email.
Verify your phone number: tap Profile (top left) > Verify device > Link your phone number, enter the code texted to you.
Before shopping, browse offers in the app and tap the (+) on each product offer to add it to your list.
Shop at the store as normal and keep your paper receipt (or link your store loyalty card for automatic tracking).
In the app, open the retailer page and tap Submit receipt, then photograph the full receipt.
Once your balance reaches $20.00 and you have redeemed at least one offer, tap the Earnings icon (top right) > Withdraw.
Choose bank account, PayPal, or gift card; tap Review, then Confirm & withdraw.
timing: PayPal: usually within 2 hours (up to 1-3 business days at peak times); bank transfer: up to 5 business days; gift cards: within the hour by email.
